headline: Textiles, chemical industry, minerals and agriculture: What was discussed at the business forum in Amman?
summary: The presidents of Uzbekistan and Jordan, meeting in Amman at a joint business forum, welcomed a signed preferential trade agreement. The deal cuts customs duties on 300 product categories and broadens bilateral cooperation.
why: Preferential trade agreements lower tariffs between partner countries, which can change export volumes and costs for exporters and importers in both markets.
original_headline: To‘qimachilik, kimyo sanoati, minerallar va agrar soha: Ammandagi biznes forumda nimalar muhokama qilindi?
